content.comment_body: Hello, can you explain how I can authorize my mobile number on the [product_name]? I have tried several methods without success. Please guide me urgently.
Are you familiar with the manual? You should refer to the [document] for [company_name] Industrial Ethernet [product_name] Operating Instructions.

Hello, thank you for your response and for pointing me to the manual. I have tried following those instructions but still failed. Whenever I send a message to the [product_name], it appears in the Diagnostics tab as 'Message sent by unauthorized number.' Is there another way to authorize my mobile number?

For authorization, you need to enter your mobile number correctly for any user and activate 'Receive SMS' for that user. You can enter the phone number either with or without the country prefix (e.g., +49 0176 123456789 or 0176 123456789). For initial testing, you may use wildcards: if you enter '*' as the user's phone number, any number will be permitted. For example, if you enter 0176 1234*, then any number starting with 01761234 (such as 017612345685 or 01761234111) will work. Hope this helps.
I am following your instructions, but it still is not working. The [product_name] continues to show 'unauthorized user.' Is there a different method for mobile number authorization?

There are no alternative methods. You could share your [product_name] configuration file, or it would be best to contact Customer Support if the configuration is correct but you continue to experience problems.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are struggling to authorize their mobile numbers with the [product_name], even after following manual instructions and advice from others. The diagnostics tab consistently reports SMS messages being sent from unauthorized numbers, causing frustration. There is limited guidance on configuration mistakes and no clear alternative solutions, making self-resolution difficult.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a simple, reliable process for authorizing a mobile number on the [product_name], along with clear error messages when the authorization fails.
